title: Rust: reject nonzero RPL Target flags in production DAO ingest (extract_updates + dao_origin envelope)
description: Child of b7z9.3 (spec 05-routing 8.6 R-05-035: reserved Target Flags octet MUST be zero; nonzero rejects the DAO before any route-state mutation). Rust production ingest ignores the octet: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/routing.rs extract_updates:1486-1503 and dao_origin.rs envelope parse accept the generalized target body (message.rs:436-438) without checking data[0]. The codec-level check already exists (rust/lichen-rpl/src/message.rs:706-720 RplTarget::from_bytes rejects nonzero flags) but is only used by codec tests. Wire the check into the verified ingest path(s): reject with the same error class as other malformed-DAO rejections BEFORE route-state mutation; add unit tests (nonzero flags -> rejected, zero flags -> accepted) using an independent oracle (python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_origin.py:296-298 already rejects nonzero flags — cross-check semantics, not bytes). Python behavior is the reference. Files: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/routing.rs, rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/dao_origin.rs (+ tests). Landable independently of the C and vector children.
close_reason: Wired R-05-035 (spec 05-routing 8.6: reserved Target Flags octet MUST be zero) into the Rust production DAO ingest: extract_updates OPT_RPL_TARGET branch (rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs) now rejects nonzero flags pre-route-mutation, and the test-only mirror dao_parents_for_source (rust/lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs) got the same check to keep its documented 'matches the root's rejection' invariant. New test nonzero_target_flags_dao_rejected_before_state_mutation (lichen-node/src/routing/tests.rs): signs a DAO with Target flags=1, expects Err(RouteRejected), then proves no replay-floor/route mutation by applying the same-origin-sequence flags=0 DAO as Ok(Applied); oracle is external (spec + python dao_origin.py data[0]!=0 reject, verified verbatim by reviewer). Suites: lichen-node 296 + lichen-rpl 237 etc all green (0 failures); fmt clean; clippy clean on touched files. Codereview 3x delegated to kimi-k3: pass1 (correctness) crashed on opencode server error after gathering evidence (vectors 46-48 confirm replay-stage precedes semantic-stage; no unguarded production Target parser) — completed myself per loop fallback: consistent with .44.7 profile (stricter than future 8.7.1 ignore-rule is intentional; python reference is stricter still), reject ordering spec-correct, PASS. pass2 (security): no defects; noted pre-existing doc/code contradiction -> filed 41at. pass3 (edge-cases): PASS (byte-flip offset determinism, oracle independence, mirror callers unaffected). Note for sibling beads: node.rs deliberately builds len-10 generalized Targets for delegated prefixes, so b7z9.3.3's vector should pin generalized-body flags semantics cross-impl; python dao_origin.py currently rejects len!=18 outright (stricter divergence worth pinning).
